INSERT INTO shared_export (export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
SELECT 
    'external_ops-2024',
    'external_ops',
    (
        SELECT json_group_array(json_object(
            'file_id', CF.file_id,
            'filename', CF.filename,
            'notes', CF.notes,
            'content', CF.content
        ))
        FROM config_files CF
    ),
    datetime('now')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM shared_export SO 
    WHERE SO.export_id = 'external_ops-2024' AND SO.recipient_org = 'external_ops'
);
